description: This file defines the RetrieveConnectionLogs command class, which is used to retrieve logs associated with a specific connection within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes methods for creating instances, parsing from JSON, and serializing to JSON, as well as metadata like command type and resource path.

classes.name: RetrieveConnectionLogs
classes.description: Immutable command class for retrieving logs of a specified connection within the Eclipse Ditto connectivity framework. It includes properties for connection ID, methods for instantiation, JSON serialization/deserialization, and overrides for equality and string representation.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create a new RetrieveConnectionLogs instance with specified connection ID and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates an instance of RetrieveConnectionLogs from a JSON string or JSON object.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Serializes the command payload into a JSON object, including the connection ID.

methods.name: getConnectionEntityId
methods.description: Returns the ConnectionId associated with this command.

methods.name: getCategory
methods.description: Returns the category of the command, which is QUERY.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer path to the resource, which is '/logs'.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance of RetrieveConnectionLogs with updated DittoHeaders.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks for equality based on connection ID and superclass equality.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Generates hash code based on connection ID and superclass.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the command, including connection ID.
